metadata.description:
If you found this, congratulations—you’ve squeezed yourself into one of the most iconic slivers of Minneapolis. Al’s Breakfast is less a restaurant than a rite of passage: 14 stools, one counter, and pancakes so legendary they practically have tenure. Tucked in Dinkytown like a culinary secret, this place rewards early risers and persistent wanderers. This Easter Egg POAP is for the hungry-hearted who know that the best places are barely wide enough to stand in—but full enough to make history. 

Category: Easter Egg 
GPS: 44.98103, -93.23552 
Map: https://www.google.com/maps/place/44.98103,-93.23552 
Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Al's_Breakfast
